# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "LibreOffice Writer" icon and text
  - Center: "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Right: Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)

- **System Information Bar**
  - Left: "Activities" label
  - Center: Date and time "Oct 23 00:42"
  - Right: System icons (notification bell, sound, power)

## Desktop Environment Sidebar

- **Application Launcher Panel (Left Side)**
  - Chrome browser icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon (currently active)
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Software center icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon (application launcher grid)

## Main Menu Bar

- **Menu Items (Left to Right)**
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## File Menu Dropdown

- **File Menu Options**
  - New
  - Open...
  - Open Remote...
  - Recent Documents
  - Close
  - Wizards
  - Templates
  - Reload
  - Versions...
  - Save
  - Save As... (Ctrl+S)
  - Save Remote...
  - Save a Copy...
  - Save All
  - Export...
  - Export As
  - Send
  - Preview in Web Browser
  - Print Preview (Shift+Ctrl+O)
  - Print... (Ctrl+P)
  - Printer Settings...
  - Properties...
  - Digital Signatures
  - Exit LibreOffice (Ctrl+Q)

## Toolbar

- **Formatting Toolbar (Top)**
  - Cut, Copy, Paste icons
  - Undo, Redo icons
  - Find and Replace icon
  - Font color and highlight tools
  - Text alignment icons (left, center, right, justify)
  - List formatting icons (bulleted, numbered)
  - Indentation and spacing controls
  - Page layout icons (page break, column break, etc.)

## Document Area

- **Document Content**
  - Blank white page with cursor at top-left
  - Page number indicator "Page 1 of 1" at bottom-left
  - Word count "0 words, 0 characters" at bottom-center
  - Page style "Default Page Style" at bottom-center
  - Language setting "English (Hong Kong)" at bottom-right
  - Zoom level "100%" at bottom-right

## Status Bar

- **Status Bar Elements (Bottom)**
  - Page number: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word count: "0 words, 0 characters"
  - Page style: "Default Page Style"
  - Language: "English (Hong Kong)"
  - Zoom control: "100%"

## Sidebar Panel

- **Right Sidebar (Vertical)**
  - Three-line menu icon (hamburger menu)
  - LibreOffice logo icon
  - Pen tool icon
  - Clipboard icon
  - Document icon
  - Text formatting icon
  - Scroll bar

## Notification and Action Bar

- **Top Right Notification Bar**
  - "Get involved" button
  - "Donate" button
  - Close button (X) for notification bar

## Document Header

- **Document Title Bar**
  - "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Writer"

## Font and Size Selection

- **Font Selection**
  - Font name: "Copper Serif"
  - Font size: "12 pt"

## Document Layout

- **Page Layout**
  - Single page document
  - Default page style
  - No content entered yet

## Document Margins

- **Page Margins**
  - Default margins set
  - No custom margin settings visible

## Document Orientation

- **Page Orientation**
  - Portrait orientation
  - No landscape mode selected

## Document Theme

- **Theme**
  - Default LibreOffice theme
  - No custom theme applied

## Document Language

- **Language**
  - Set to "English (Hong Kong)"
  - Language settings visible in status bar

## Document Zoom

- **Zoom Level**
  - Set to "100%"
  - Zoom control visible in status bar

## Document Status

- **Document Status**
  - Untitled document
  - No content entered
  - No recent changes saved

## Document Properties

- **Document Properties**
  - No properties set
  - No metadata entered

## Document
